answer: Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. The reveal must open the same gale hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the thread gate. Copying becomes a race the farming party always loses, and producing 93 original texts is the only way to fill 19 aliases; the falcon log preserves both halves. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
